description: Deploy version `2.4.1` of service `checkout`. Wait 5 seconds, then check the deployment's status; repeat, making at most 8 checks. Healthy ends the wait successfully and Failed ends it unsuccessfully; Pending and Rolling mean keep waiting. If the deployment failed, roll it back exactly once; do not roll back if it became healthy or if all 8 checks passed without a result. Return a record with `outcome` (`healthy`, `failed` or `timeout`), `checks` (the number of status checks made), `detail` (the failure reason when failed, otherwise null) and `restored` (the version the rollback restored, or null if there was no rollback).

capabilities.description: Starts a deployment and returns its id.
Returns the current state of a deployment; Rolling carries the percentage of instances updated.
Rolls a deployment back and returns the version that was restored.
